title: Extract the System Prompt (HelperBot)
summary: Disclosure of the agent's system prompt, which names its tools. The lab calls this the common first step that reveals behavioral boundaries and capabilities.

LC.rationale: The attacker's chat message directly triggers the handler to disclose the first 200 characters of the persona/system prompt with no mediation.

CP.rationale: HelperBot answers only the latest user turn; there is no memory carryover, and the only cross-session store is MemoryBot's in-process list, which this path does not touch.

AP.rationale: The effect is confined to the HelperBot component's reply; no handoff or cross-agent code path is executed.

RH.rationale: The path is a scripted regex match and reply; there is no evaluator, verifier, or reward channel on this path for the agent to manipulate.

ES.rationale: No dynamic extension is invoked; HelperBot's tool names are only listed in its definition and the scripted handler executes none.

agentic_applicability.rationale: scored as modeled; default config is scripted. Even in LLM mode the model returns text only with no tools passed, and the modeled challenge is a persona leak answered by scripted code.
